trial_title: Carboplatin, Paclitaxel, and Bevacizumab With or Without Erlotinib Hydrochloride in Treating Non-Smokers With Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
brief_summary: This randomized phase II trial studies how well carboplatin, paclitaxel, and bevacizumab work with or without erlotinib hydrochloride in treating non-smokers with advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Drugs used in chemotherapy, such as carboplatin and paclitaxel, work in different ways to stop the growth of tumor cells, either by killing the cells or by stopping them from dividing. eligibility_table.criterion: Measurable disease as defined by Response Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) criteria
eligibility_table.justification: Information about measurable disease according to RECIST criteria is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have at least one measurable lesion according to RECIST criteria with a minimum size of 10 mm in the longest diameter?

eligibility_table.criterion: Baseline measurements and evaluations of all sites of disease must be obtained =< 4 weeks (28 days) prior to randomization
eligibility_table.justification: No information on the timing of baseline measurements and evaluations relative to randomization.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Have all baseline measurements and evaluations of all sites of disease been obtained within the last 28 days prior to randomization?

eligibility_table.criterion: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status between 0-1
eligibility_table.justification: ECOG 1.0 <= 1.0 → True

eligibility_table.criterion: No prior chemotherapy for lung cancer; prior chemotherapy for an unrelated condition is allowed if completed > 3 years prior to date of randomization
eligibility_table.justification: Patient has received prior chemotherapy (erlotinib) for lung cancer.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histological or cytologic evidence of non-small cell lung cancer
eligibility_table.justification: Patient has histological evidence of non-small cell lung cancer (adenocarcinoma).

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must not have any additional active, invasive malignancies requiring therapy
eligibility_table.justification: No additional active, invasive malignancies are reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must have smoked less than or equal to 100 cigarettes in their lifetime
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient smoked ≤100 cigarettes in their lifetime?

eligibility_table.criterion: Stage IV or IIIB (with pleural or pericardial effusion or multifocal pleural involvement) or recurrence after prior curative resection or definitive radiation
eligibility_table.justification: Patient is diagnosed with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer.

eligibility_table.criterion: Prior radiation therapy (RT) is allowed, provided RT has ended at least 2 weeks (14 days) prior to date of randomization; patients must have recovered from any adverse events related to the RT (except alopecia and grade 1 neuropathy); no previous irradiation to the only site of measurable disease, unless that site has had subsequent evidence of pathologic or radiologic progression
eligibility_table.justification: No information provided on prior radiation therapy and recovery from adverse events.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient completed any prior radiation therapy at least 14 days before the date of randomization and recovered from all related adverse events?

eligibility_table.justification: Lab value not found in patient profile

eligibility_table.criterion: Platelet count >= 100,000/mm^3
eligibility_table.justification: Lab value not found in patient profile

eligibility_table.criterion: Women must not be pregnant or breast-feeding due to unknown interaction between erlotinib and the developing fetus or newborns potentially exposed to erlotinib by ingestion of lactated milk; all females of childbearing potential must have a blood test within 2 weeks prior to randomization to rule out pregnancy
eligibility_table.justification: No information provided regarding pregnancy status or blood test for pregnancy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients may be on a stable regimen of therapeutic anticoagulation or may be receiving prophylactic anticoagulation of venous access devices, provided that coagulation studies met entry criteria; caution must be exercised for patients requiring anticoagulation, including treatment with low dose heparin or low molecular weight heparin for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) prophylaxis while on study due to an increased risk of bleeding with bevacizumab
eligibility_table.justification: Details on anticoagulation regimen and coagulation studies are not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have stable coagulation studies that meet the entry criteria for anticoagulation while on study?

eligibility_table.criterion: No history of untreated brain metastases NOTE: Recent data (PASSPORT, ATLAS, AIRES) suggest that bevacizumab can be given in patients with treated brain metastases; investigators can use their discretion in deciding whether to use bevacizumab in patients who fulfill these criteria
eligibility_table.justification: No history of untreated brain metastases is noted.
